basic_details.job_title: IIT Bhilai Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 4 Project Assistant, Project Associate Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Department of CSE at the Indian Institute of Technology, Bhilai (Durg, Chhattisgarh) is hiring 4 Project Assistant (Technical) and Project Associate (Technical) staff on a temporary basis in the Meity-sponsored project "FinTech Security with (or without) Blockchain". Pay is Rs. 28,000 – 41,000 (Project Assistant) and Rs. 35,000 – 50,000 (Project Associate), both consolidated, for 4 months, extendable based on performance. A CS/IT diploma with experience, or BE/BTech, MSc or MCA in CS/IT, is the essential qualification. Applications go by email to the Principal Investigator before 05:00 pm

qualification.details: Android app development (Java) Full-Stack web development (ReactJS, NodeJS, Express, PHP, MongoDB) Familiarity with penetration testing (e.g. Burp suite) APK testing (e.g. Frida) Blockchain Cryptography Ethereum (Quorum/Besu), Hyperledger Fabric Smart contracts (Solidity, Chaincode) Web3 security tools (Slither, MythX, zk-SNARKs, etc.) Scalable backends (Node.js, Python) The notice adds: "If you're into ZKPs, Layer 2s, or secure infra - even better!" | Candidates should check the official notification for the exact wording of each post's eligibility.

how_to_apply: Fill out the application form attached to the advertisement.
Email the form and CV to the Principal Investigator (PI), Prof. Souradyuti Paul, at [email protected].
Send the email before 05:00 pm on 21/11/2026, which the notice calls the hard submission deadline.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be provided to the candidate for the interview. The appointment will be governed by the terms and conditions of the Institute/Funding agency particularly applicable to the project, as and when required. The selected candidate will have to join duty immediately on receipt of the offer. IIT Bhilai, based on the performance of the candidates, reserves the right to fill or not to fill any or all the posts.

content_sections.heading: IIT Bhilai Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Project Assistant: Rs. 28,000 – 41,000/- (consolidated); Project Associate: Rs. 35,000 – 50,000/- (consolidated)

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice states 4 positions in total across the two posts. It does not print how many positions belong to each post, and it gives no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: For each post, a candidate must satisfy one of the listed qualifications. The notice prints the age limit as "35" for Project Assistant (Technical) and "45" for Project Associate (Technical). It does not print an age cut-off date or any age relaxation. Android app development (Java) Full-Stack web development (ReactJS, NodeJS, Express, PHP, MongoDB) Familiarity with penetration testing (e.g. Burp suite) APK testing (e.g. Frida) Blockchain Cryptography Ethereum (Quorum/Besu), Hyperledger Fabric Smart contracts (Solidity, Chaincode) Web3 security tools (Slither, MythX, zk-SNARKs, etc.) Scalable backends (Node.js, Python) The notice adds: "If you're into ZKPs, Layer 2s, or secure infra - even better!" Candidates should check the official notification for the exact wording of each post's eligibility.

rows.essential_qualification: A 3-year diploma in CS/IT plus 2 years of job experience in CS/IT; OR BE/BTech in CS/IT; OR MSc in CS/IT; OR MCA from a recognized university

A 3-year diploma in CS/IT plus 4 years of job experience in CS/IT; OR BE/BTech in CS/IT plus 2 years of job experience in CS/IT; OR MSc in CS/IT plus 2 years of job experience in CS/IT; OR MCA plus 2 years of job experience in CS/IT

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Both posts carry consolidated pay: Rs. 28,000 – 41,000/- for Project Assistant (Technical) and Rs. 35,000 – 50,000/- for Project Associate (Technical). The notice prints the second pay range under the label "Project assistant" within the Project Associate entry. The engagement is on a temporary basis for 4 months, extendable based on performance. The notice refers to the engagement as a fellowship in one condition and says it may be terminated with a 30-day notice before completion of the tenure if performance till date is not deemed satisfactory.

faq.question: Q1. How many positions are there in IIT Bhilai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice states 4 positions in total for Project Assistant (Technical) and Project Associate (Technical). The split between the two posts is not printed.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted by email before 05:00 pm on 21/11/2026, which the notice calls the hard deadline.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Project Assistant (Technical)?
faq.answer: One of the following: a 3-year diploma in CS/IT plus 2 years of job experience in CS/IT, BE/BTech in CS/IT, MSc in CS/IT, or MCA from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Project Associate (Technical)?
faq.answer: One of the following: a 3-year diploma in CS/IT plus 4 years of job experience in CS/IT, or BE/BTech, MSc in CS/IT or MCA each plus 2 years of job experience in CS/IT.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The notice prints an age limit of 35 for Project Assistant (Technical) and 45 for Project Associate (Technical).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Project Assistant (Technical) is paid Rs. 28,000 – 41,000/- consolidated, and Project Associate (Technical) Rs. 35,000 – 50,000/- consolidated.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for IIT Bhilai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Email the filled-out application form and a well-written CV to the Principal Investigator at [email protected] before 05:00 pm on 21/11/2026.

faq.question: Q8. What subject line should I write in the email?
faq.answer: The subject line is "MeiTy-NOV26-ProjectAssistant/Associate".

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the notice describes it as a temporary engagement in a sponsored research project for 4 months, extendable based on performance.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be provided to the candidate for the interview, according to the notice.
